descriptionChirho: An Aramaic masculine noun meaning 'son' (cognate to Hebrew ben), used in the construct state (bnei 'sons of') to express patrilineal descent or group membership. Found in the Aramaic portions of Ezra and Daniel. All clusters represent the same lexical meaning with variation only in pronominal suffix (bare construct, with 3ms suffix 'his sons', with 3mp suffix 'their children') or conjunction (with waw 'and sons of'). The multilingual glosses uniformly translate as sons/children (arb: bani, deu: Soehne, spa: hijos, hin: putra/bete, kor: adeul/jason).
